newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ occupancy rates continue to rise - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ occupancy rates continue to rise - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand accommodation occupancy rose slightly in October, up to 31 percent, Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) said on Tuesday.
It said this was the highest occupancy rate to date since the survey began in July. Hotel and motel occupancy rates were up on September, with both at 53 percent.
Wellington and Auckland regions had the highest overall occupancy rate, at 50 percent. Other regions recording high rates were Canterbury, 33.1 percent, and the West Coast, 31 percent.

Accommodation occupancy excluding caravan parks/camping grounds was 50 percent in October, up from 47.4 percent in September, while the rate for caravan parks and camping grounds was 9.1 percent. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
